text: I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or significant weight loss. However, I have been feeling short of breath when I exert myself and have been experiencing dizziness. speaker: Doctor
text: I must clarify that Z-Syndrome is not a recognized medical condition, and your symptoms of exertional dyspnea, dizziness, and cold-induced finger pain are highly suggestive of Raynaud's phenomenon and potential anemia or connective tissue disease.
